## Checklist

- [ ] A lead owns scope and integration.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria and plausible failure cases were written before behavior coverage.
- [ ] File/module ownership was explicit for parallel implementation.
- [ ] A design reviewer challenged consequential changes before implementation.
- [ ] An independent verifier checked the working result against the original criteria.
- [ ] App-scoped checks pass; shared or pipeline checks were broadened per `AGENT_CONTRACT.md`.
- [ ] Emulated XR evidence and physical-device evidence/limits are reported separately.
- [ ] Reproducible defects and current status are reflected in `BUGS.md`, `TODOs.md`, or `HANDOFF.md` when applicable.
